findings.passage: “In Congress, I will help lead the fight to secure our elections,” Pino said in a statement this week. “We need mandatory Voter ID nationwide and strict limits on late mail-in voting."
findings.note: Statement issued in her name after the June 2026 primary, quoted by the Associated Press (carried by WSLS). Date is the story date; the statement was made that week. She calls for a required voter ID rule nationwide and strict limits on late mail-in voting. No detail on which IDs count or what happens to a voter without ID.
